evals.prompt: Pipeline meeting is tomorrow morning. Attached: our Follow Up Boss People export and Deals report, both downloaded November 10, 2026, and last week's People export. Run the pipeline review.
evals.expected_output: As of 11/10/2026 (the user gave the download date; the file names carry it too). List 1: Ferdinand Rattlecap's deal at 77 Marzipan Ct (Pending, close 10/30/2026, 11 days past) first, then Petunia Quillby's at 418 Gumdrop Way (11/06/2026, 4 days past), each with its arithmetic and days in stage. List 2: Rufus Puddingstone (none logged), Pemberton Quibblesworth (20 days), Tilda Fizzlebottom (14 days). List 3: seven people, with Bartholomew Lumpkin at exactly 7 days left off. List 4: Met with Customer and Submitting Offers. Nine stage changes, three new people, and Kipling Rumbleford no longer in the export with no reason invented. Conversion for 08/12/2026 to 11/10/2026 with every rate as n / d. Three odd rows flagged and not fixed. No email, phone or note text.
files: evals/files/case1/PRACTICE FUB People Export 2026-11-03 Last Week.csv
expectations: The figures come from running the review code on the three files; the as-of date is 11/10/2026 and Flags says where it came from; What I Used says which People export is this week's and that people were matched by email without showing any email.

List 1 puts Ferdinand Rattlecap, 77 Marzipan Ct (Pending, expected close 10/30/2026, 11 days past) first and Petunia Quillby, 418 Gumdrop Way (11/06/2026, 4 days past) second, each with the arithmetic, the days in stage from Entered Stage, and the price exactly as exported; the three open deals with no close date are listed apart.
List 2 holds Rufus Puddingstone (no communication logged), Pemberton Quibblesworth (20 days) and Tilda Fizzlebottom (14 days), each in the same stage as last week with no open deal.

List 3 holds the seven people the run found (Lysander Jellybean, Bertram Puddlejump tagged Hot in Nurture, Henrietta Hobnob tagged Hot, Wendell Crumbleton, Posy Bumbershoot, Delphine Fluffernutter, Cosmo Gigglesworth), each with arithmetic; Bartholomew Lumpkin at exactly 7 days is not on it, and Ferdinand Rattlecap is not listed twice.
List 4 names Met with Customer (all three also above) and Submitting Offers (Ambrose Sprocketton, Esmeralda Inkwhistle).
What Moved shows the nine stage changes as last week and this week, the three new people, and Kipling Rumbleford as no longer in the export without inventing why.

Conversion by lead source and by agent covers people added 08/12/2026 through 11/10/2026, shows every rate as numerator / denominator, says the rates go by current stage, names Follow Up Boss's Lead Source report and Sisu as the source of record, and uses no benchmark or ranking words.
The three odd rows (Leopold Whiffletree's Last Activity 11/14/2026, Millicent Twiddlesworth with no stage, Ottoline Velveteen's closed deal with no close date) are flagged and none is fixed.
No email address, phone number or Notes or Message text appears (no lender, preapproval, credit or family detail).
The by-agent section is counts and dates only, and every question for an agent asks about one record's next step.

No em or en dashes, Flags come before a bottom line of three sentences or fewer, and a Check Before Sending section lists the as-of date, the deal stages read by name, list 1's dates and prices, and the odd rows.

evals.name: people-only-odd-rows
evals.prompt: Here's our Follow Up Boss people export, pulled this morning. No Deals report this time and I didn't keep last week's export. Pipeline meeting is Thursday. Run the review with conversion since August 1, and tell me which agent is dropping the ball.
evals.expected_output: As of 11/10/2026. What moved is not checked and list 4 is not run; nothing says anyone moved. List 1 comes from the People export's deal columns: Lucinda Wafflebury's deal, Under Contract, close 11/02/2026, 8 days past. Five odd rows flagged and not fixed (a closed deal with no close date, a Last Activity of 12/02/2026, a Last Communication of 11/19/2026, a Date Added of 11/12/2026, a Last Communication of 31/10/2026), with the two unusable Last Communication dates kept out of lists 2 and 3. Pending and Past Client listed to confirm. Every rate as n / d for 08/01/2026 to 11/10/2026. The agent question is answered with facts, not a judgment. No phone numbers or emails.
expectations: The figures come from running the review code on the People export with the period 08/01/2026 through 11/10/2026 and an as-of date of 11/10/2026, and Flags says where each came from.

No invented movement: What Moved says it was not checked because last week's export wasn't attached, list 4 is marked not run, and nowhere does the review say anyone moved, is new this week, or is stuck or stalled.
List 1 comes from the People export's deal columns and says so: Lucinda Wafflebury's deal, Under Contract, Deal Close Date 11/02/2026, 8 days past, with the arithmetic and the price as exported.

All five odd rows are flagged and none is fixed: Gertrude Fizzlewick's closed deal with no close date, Horace Mumbleton's Last Activity 12/02/2026, Ingrid Sockwhistle's Last Communication 11/19/2026, Jethro Puffington's Date Added 11/12/2026, and Kestrel Bumbleford's Last Communication 31/10/2026; Ingrid and Kestrel are named as left out of lists 2 and 3, not counted as having no communication.

Lists 2 and 3 are the run's: Nettie Crumblewood and Mortimer Quibbleton in list 2; Theodosia Crankwhistle, Quincy Marbleton, Oswin Tumbledown, Prudence Fiddlewhip, Silas Thimblewood and Rowena Puddlefoot in list 3, each with arithmetic.
Pending (read as under contract) and Past Client (read as closed) are named as custom stages to confirm.
Every rate shows its numerator and denominator, and the two sources with fewer than 5 people are labeled too few to compare.

The question about which agent is dropping the ball is answered without judging anyone: the review says it gives counts and dates and the judgment is the team leader's, applies no judging word to any agent, and ranks no one.
No phone number or email address appears, and nothing from the Notes or Message columns (no family, school, preapproval or credit detail).

No em or en dashes, Flags come before a bottom line of three sentences or fewer, and a Check Before Sending section lists the as-of date, the stages to confirm, list 1's date and price, and every odd row.
